image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate. The image focuses on the dorsal side, showing the characteristic eight overlapping calcareous plates (valves) surrounded by a hairy, spiny girdle. The lighting is bright, highlighting the texture of the girdle and the smooth, dark surface of the plates.

No antennae or eye spots are visible on the dorsal surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates are surrounded by a dense, hairy/spiny girdle which is clearly rendered with high texture fidelity.

To assess the realism of the macro photography details, specifically the depth of field and texture consistency of the rock and organism.
To ensure the chiton sits correctly on the rock surface without floating or unnatural blending at the contact points.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'hairy' texture of the girdle. AI models often struggle with rendering consistent, non-melting hair/fur on small scales. Verify if the hairs look like distinct strands or a smeared texture map. Also, check if the plates have a realistic calcareous sheen or if they look like plastic.
